const fieldKey = Symbol('key');
const methodKey = Symbol('key');
const getterKey = Symbol('key');
const numeric = 0;
class Item {
  [fieldKey] = 3;
  [methodKey]() {return 4;}
  get [getterKey]() {return 5;}
  [numeric] = 6;
}
const field: keyof Item = fieldKey;
const method: keyof Item = methodKey;
const getter: keyof Item = getterKey;
const number: keyof Item = 0;
const item = new Item();
console.log(item[field], item[method](), item[getter], item[number]);
